other_conditions: The applicant must be pursuing or have completed an undergraduate, graduate, or postgraduate degree from a recognized university, college, or institution in India.
The applicant must have his own laptop for the internship.
The internship benefit can be availed only once during a financial year.
Applicants must maintain a minimum of 60% attendance during the internship period.
Applicants must apply online at least one month before the desired internship period.
benefits_summary: Provides unpaid, practical professional exposure and skill development in the operations of a Central Public Sector Enterprise focused on scheduled caste community development.
documents_required: No Objection Certificate (Format enclosed in Annexure-A)
